scope: Read-only DS7/DS8 code comparison, all four freeze records and completed 1471-frame numeric observations/predictions/events plus full access seal. No prediction/scoring/test rerun, no raw GT/RGB/depth pixel open, no frozen file modification.

unchanged_config_fields.inferred_policy: Use retained-measurement cohort if usable; otherwise inferred-only cohort, never mix medians. Inferred uncertainty floor 60 mm is an assumption, not calibrated accuracy.
unchanged_config_fields.fallback: Own-branch native/committed alias; no temporary H1
unchanged_config_fields.scope: EXPOSED_OFFLINE_V2_REPROJECTED; no annotation assistance; upstream RGB and future cleaning

changed_variable.roi: Per exclusive 8-connected mask component, true L2 center-to-nearest-zero distance with zero-padded crop; select d>=max(1.5,min(3,0.5*dmax)); union every selected component.
changed_variable.inputs: Current prediction mask and overlap occupancy only; no depth, reference, answer or future mask determines threshold.
changed_variable.metadata: component pieces are original mask geometry, not depth surfaces; samples means geometric ROI pixels, not valid measurements.
changed_variable.downstream: P1 adaptive raw and P2 adaptive retained/inferred observations feed each own DepthState and depth likelihood. Scalar aggregation, controller, geometry costs, quality gates, missing-row model and log9 are unchanged.
changed_variable.audit_additions: Explicit actual_selected_mad_mm and core_mad_semantics plus ROI geometry/fact IDs do not change the inference policy.

background_and_controls.runner: extract_frame uses original profiles and validates old n/fraction/median/MAD; original row/profiles drive triggers, masks, bank quality and 2D geometry. P0/D2 use original objects; P1 uses adaptive_raw; P2 uses restored.

temporal_contract.decision_evidence: Runner computes current-frame observations, freezes legal pre history before suspect, requires first post only at q and cutoff=q; association forecasts from frozen pre and current q measurements. Manager mask accesses are current or last group frame, not future indices.
temporal_contract.source_reader: RestoredDepth image arrays are indexed only by requested current global frame. All-frame H5 timestamps/index/shape metadata are loaded at initialization.
temporal_contract.preloading: Sources, scanner/assignments, time metadata and source hashes cover the full selected segment before replay. This is not a claim of zero future file bytes read.
temporal_contract.restored_boundary: Unchanged existing v2 used upstream RGB and future cleaning. Direct reader behavior does not establish causal online equivalence.

inferred_mad_contract.actual: cohorts.inferred.mad and actual_selected_mad_mm retain actual median absolute deviation.
inferred_mad_contract.effective: For selected inferred only, core.mad=max(actualMAD,60/1.4826) adapts the old estimator to an assumed single-observation sigma floor 60mm; retained and inferred median cohorts are not mixed.
inferred_mad_contract.qualification: Eligibility still uses pre-inflation actual cohort statistics and old 16/.2/60 rule. Empty/invalid measurements remain unavailable.
inferred_mad_contract.uncertainty_limit: The sigma is assumed, not calibrated accuracy. WLS can reduce fitted forecast uncertainty; provenance/sample correlation is not calibrated. UNKNOWN surface identity and no physical-mm GT remain.

freezing.project_execution_and_scorer_coverage: Current runner, preparation, launch, controller, association, measurement, adaptive core, scorer, event audit/checks, old depth/state/manager/Bridge, legacy official helpers and DS1 postseal are frozen.
freezing.external_projection_code: Geometry and aligned projection sources are separately in restored_sources artifact seals.
freezing.dependency_scope: ROOT-external library implementations are not all individually file-hashed in code_sha256. ENVIRONMENT records Python, NumPy/OpenCV/h5py/SciPy versions; do not claim complete binary/environment byte sealing.
freezing.score_gate: Actual evaluate/event_audit/score_checks paths required, no nonexistent build_evaluation. Gate checks all prediction/source/code seals and access audit before direct label opens, then native/D2/P0 equivalence and history/first-public bindings.
freezing.v3_guard_detail: Frozen launch forbids restoration/v3/ and recorded slice audit includes it; REQUIRED_ACCESS_TOKENS omits this particular token, so the scorer does not independently require that token in the submitted audit. Current frozen guard is unchanged and this is a validation-scope limitation, not an observed v3 read.

reporting_limits: Changing to L2 threshold>=3 also changes broad/irregular ROI boundary pixels compared with old 7x7 square erosion; the intervention is an ROI rule across all source masks, not only a handpicked thin-fish repair.
Union core statistics still pool mask components into one scalar median; geometric components do not certify physical fish surfaces.
Legacy q_qualified_piece_count may be null and q_piece_references empty because adaptive ROI pieces live under roi_geometry and are not qualified depth-surface pieces.
Inherited DS7_DEPTH_NUMERIC provenance label in controller identifies the reused mechanism, not the trial version; source/read/arm/segment facts identify actual DS8.

Raw native support, offline P2 native support and P2-vs-raw increment are separate score_support_layers. Failure of the strict P2 increment rule does not erase a separately observed raw or offline native comparison.
Recorded synthetic PASS and first-three-segment invariants establish engineering checks only. No tracking gain or surface/physical accuracy conclusion is drawn here.

full_seal_snapshot.final_full_gate: Official evaluator VERIFICATION is separately present; this review independently verifies output/control/background/event timing and access seals, and does not invoke scoring.
